name: Police Car
summary: Ink sketch white and blue police car with a flashing roof light bar, side view facing right; for emergency scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the tyres stand on y

params.name: s
params.note: room scale: about 760 px wide and 340 px tall at s = 1

params.name: color
params.note: body colour (white by default); the blue stripe is fixed

params.name: anim
params.note: siren = the roof light bar flashes red and blue; wheels still roll when vx is not 0

params.name: vx
params.note: horizontal speed in px per frame (negative = left; set flip too)

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the car faces left

author: krakujs
